items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Who played the piano? Joe Harris. Harris' finance, he and his brother in the finance business now.

ctx.x: Was there a trombone playing in the band?
No, no, no, two saxes and trumpet. And drums and piano. Who played the piano? Joe Harris. Harris' finance, he and his brother in the finance business now.
No bass? No bass. No, we didn't need that.
